_comment: Test-only. Builds a directory that IS a theme by every cheap test — it
exists, it has a config.php, and the site setting can name it — but sets no
$THEME->parents. Moodle's find_theme_config() returns null on that
(theme_config.php:2107), load() falls back to Boost, and it says so only to
a debugging(DEBUG_NORMAL) this runtime does not display.
Used by LIVE check 7 to prove exit code 33 really fires. No REAL theme is
broken this way, so it has to be built; it lives in a fixture rather than
inline in verify.sh because the PHP needs single quotes and the check runs
It is never reachable from a preview link: the builder cannot emit an
arbitrary runPhpCode, and nothing reads this file outside the gate.
